description: (WFS) Geoinformation Eisenbahn-Bundesamt is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Geoinformationen des Eisenbahn-Bundesamtes. Weiterführende Informationen zu den jeweiligen Features befinden sich in den jeweiligen Metadaten zum Feature. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are bahnlärm, ballungsraumstatistik-ulr, beeintraechtigung-flut-2021, behörde, beteiligung-100m-raster. It offers 11 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
